email.subject1: a signal play for Agent Studio
email.body1:
John, saw Agora launched Agent Studio, your no-code platform for building and scaling voice AI agents.

A new self-serve platform usually surfaces far more in-market accounts than the BD team can cover by hand, and that is where the early adopters slip away. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Agora off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for Agora.

When a platform like Agent Studio launches, the developer accounts worth touching multiply faster than reps can ramp. Most teams can't say how many meetings they actually need to convert that demand, so the gap surfaces late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Agora needs to turn Agent Studio interest into closed revenue this quarter.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for Agora.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Agora's reply rate likely compares to other developer-platform teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
John, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority around the Agent Studio launch, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a launch quarter is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a developer-platform motion? I'll tailor it to Agora either way.
